prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Soil moisture can be mapped at high spatial resolution by fusing radar and optical satellite imagery, with validation against in-situ sensors showing root-mean-square error of 0.034 m³/m³ across agricultural fields.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08411","field":"abstract","quote":"combines Sentinel-1 C-band backscatter with Sentinel-2 surface reflectance to estimate volumetric soil moisture content"}]},{"text":"Crop simulation models can be integrated with satellite Earth observation data through ensemble Kalman filter assimilation to generate spatially explicit yield surfaces and management recommendations at field resolution.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08419","field":"abstract","quote":"assimilates Sentinel-2 leaf area index retrievals into the APSERNA crop simulation model via an ensemble Kalman filter"}]},{"text":"Agricultural monitoring workflows combining multiple remote sensing products have been deployed operationally at continental scale with processing latency under 5 hours, demonstrating feasibility for near-real-time advisory services.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08420","field":"abstract","quote":"End-to-end latency from Sentinel data availability to dashboard update was reduced from 48 hours in a prototype on-premise system to 4.2 hours"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher's expertise spans crop simulation integration, soil moisture retrieval, and operational deployment of agricultural decision-support systems [SYN-PUB-08419, SYN-PUB-08411, SYN-PUB-08420], but the records show no direct experience with evapotranspiration modelling, FAO Penman-Monteith implementation, or coupling soil water-holding capacity maps to irrigation scheduling—the core technical challenge."}
